homeTitle: A table ready when you are
homeDescription: Play with friends in your browsers, or share a screen for a local game.
multiplayerBeta: Multiplayer beta · invite friends to your table
homeContinueTitle: Pick up where you left off
homeModesIntro: Choose a scenario when you set up a table, online or on one screen.
homeModeSeafaringAbout: Build ships, sail to new islands and find gold. Every map also comes in a version for five or six players.
homeModeSeafaringKnightsAbout: Both expansions at once: sail to new islands while knights guard your cities against the barbarians. Every seafaring map, for three to four or five to six players.
homeLibraryIntro: Open a game file someone exported, or a full save you kept.
setupDescription: Choose seats and rules before the first placement.
nameRequired: Enter a player name that is not blank.
creationFailed: Could not create the game. Check the setup and try again.
saveFailed: The new game could not be saved.
loadFailed: The saved game could not be loaded.
saveConflict: This game changed in another tab. Reload before continuing.
publicReplaysDescription: Open an exported game to view its public board and event history.
publicReplayFailed: This public replay could not be verified or opened.
publicReplayExportFailed: The signed public replay could not be exported.
publicReplayReadOnly: Read-only public history. Private hands and a full game audit are not included.
fullSaveDescription: Imported files open as paused, read-only snapshots. Importing a save never restores control of a live game.
fullSaveListFailed: Imported saves could not be loaded.
fullSaveImportFailed: This full save could not be verified or stored.
fullSavePassphraseRequired: This file needs its passphrase. Enter it above and import again.
fullSaveWrongPassphrase: That passphrase could not open the private part of this file.
fullSavePublicOnly: Public history and voting safety only
importTransferTitle: Request this seat on this device
importTransferDescription: This saved file provides a history checkpoint only. A current player must send a signed transfer invitation and approve the move; this file cannot give this device control.
importTransferInviteLabel: Current player's signed transfer invitation URL
importTransferInvalidInvite: Enter a valid signed seat transfer invitation URL.
importTransferWrongGame: This invitation is for another game. Open the invitation for this saved game.
importTransferWrongSeat: This invitation names a seat that is not in this saved game.
importTransferCheckpointHint: The current player still needs to approve the move. The saved file is checked against the live certified history before this device offers keys.
importTransferCheckpointInvalid: This saved checkpoint does not match the live game and seat. No transfer offer was made.
fullSaveOpenFailed: This imported save could not be verified or opened.
fullSavePausedDescription: This file is for viewing and review. It cannot resume play or cast votes.
fullSavePrivateLocked: This file contains an encrypted private package. This view does not unlock or install it.
fullSaveExportDescription: Choose what to include in a portable copy of this game.
fullSavePublicContents: Public history and voting safety are included by default. They do not restore control of the game.
fullSaveIncludePrivate: Include private material and escrow, encrypted with a passphrase
fullSavePrivateWarning: This adds your private game material and escrow package. Anyone with this file and its passphrase may read the included private data. Keep both safe and share them only with people you trust.
fullSavePassphraseMinimum: Use at least 12 characters. This passphrase is required to open the private package.
fullSavePassphraseInvalid: Use a passphrase of at least 12 characters to export private material.
fullSaveExportFailed: The full save could not be prepared.
settingsDescription: Choose how Hexfield looks and handles shared-screen turns.
hotseatCover: Cover private hands when control changes
onlineCreateDescription: Choose your game, then invite friends to the table.
onlineServerHint: Only change this if you have your own server. Use its ws:// or wss:// address.
onlineOpenFailed: The room could not be opened. Check your connection or try a fresh invitation.
onlineJoinDescription: Paste the invitation your friend shared with you.
onlineInviteInvalid: That invitation could not be opened. Check the full code or link, or ask the host for a fresh one.
onlineLobbyMissingTitle: This room is not open in this tab
onlineLobbyMissingBody: Ask the host for a new invitation. If the game already started, open its saved game from the home screen on this browser.
onlineResumeUnsupportedVersion: This saved game uses multiplayer version {{version}}, which this build cannot resume. Its data is still saved on this device. Start a new room with everyone on the current version.
onlineWaitingForHost: Waiting for the host to open the room.
onlineConnectionNotice: Some room connections need attention. The room will keep trying to reconnect.
onlineProtocolMismatch: The host is using a different app version ({{version}}). Everyone should refresh the app before joining.
onlineEngineMismatch: The host is using different game rules ({{version}}). Everyone should refresh the app before joining.
onlineInvalidLobbyMessage: A room update could not be verified.
onlineActionFailed: That room change could not be saved. Check the connection and try again.
onlineInviteDescription: Share the invitation link with your friends to bring them to your table.
onlineCopyFailed: The invitation could not be copied. Check browser clipboard access.
onlineBotHostedByPlayer: Bot · runs on another player’s device
onlineSeatRequestPending: Waiting for the host to seat you…
onlineSeatRequestUnavailable: The lobby changed and this seat is no longer free. Pick another seat.
onlineSeatRequestStale: The lobby kept changing while you asked for this seat. Try again.
onlineSeatRequestInvalid: The host could not seat you here.
onlineSeatRequestTimeout: The host did not answer. Check the connection and try again.
onlineSettingsReadyReset: Saving a change asks every player to ready up again.
onlineSettingsReadOnly: Everyone plays with these settings. Only the host can change them before starting.
onlineSeedHint: The same seed and map settings produce the same board. Cards are still shuffled afresh.
onlineTakeoverDisclosure: A takeover gives the remaining players access to the missing player's recovery secrets and replaces their seat with a bot. This cannot be undone.
onlineTakeoverFourHumans: Takeover needs four human players. Games with fewer humans pause until the missing player returns.
onlineTakeoverSummaryVote: After {{count}} seconds offline, remaining players can vote to replace the missing player with a bot.
onlineTakeoverSummaryAuto: After {{count}} seconds offline, the remaining players can replace the missing player with a bot automatically.
onlineTakeoverVoteWaiting: If four humans started this game, the remaining players can vote after {{count}} seconds with a connected quorum.
onlineTakeoverAutoWaiting: If four humans started this game, takeover starts after {{count}} seconds with a connected quorum.
onlineTakeoverApproval: Replace {{player}} with a {{level}} bot? This request is signed for the current game state.
onlineTakeoverApproved: Your approval is recorded on this device. Waiting for the other players and certification.
onlineTakeoverTooEarly: Wait for the certified offline notice and the full quorum-qualified delay.
onlineTakeoverWaitingMarker: Waiting for players to certify that this seat is offline.
onlineTakeoverWaitingDelay: Waiting for the full disconnect delay while enough players remain connected.
onlineTakeoverQuorum: Not enough players are connected to authorize a takeover.
onlineTakeoverFailed: The takeover request could not be accepted. The game may have changed; check the connection and try again.
onlineStartPreparation: Fill every seat and have everyone ready up to start.
onlineDisconnectPolicy: Players keep their seats if they disconnect. Reopen the saved game in the same browser to reconnect. Play waits whenever the missing player is needed.
onlineStartFailed: The game could not finish starting. Check the connection and try this start again.
onlineLeaveConfirmBody: This closes your room connection. Started games stay saved in this browser. To return to an unstarted room, ask for a new invitation.
onlineLeaveFailed: The room connection could not be closed cleanly. Try again.
onlineStartWaitingAgreement: Waiting for the remaining confirmations. Keep this tab open.
onlineStartRetired: This start was cancelled. Create a new room to try again.
onlineGameWaitingPeers: Waiting for a connection to {{players}}. Keep this tab open.
onlineGameLeaveBody: Leaving closes your connection. The other players may need to wait for you.
onlineAuditFailed: The game audit found an inconsistency
onlineAuditWaiting: Waiting for players to reveal their cards for the audit…
onlineAuditUnavailable: The game audit could not finish
onlineAuditPending: The game audit has not finished yet
onlineGameHalted: This game's setup is no longer secure. Play has stopped.
onlineGameHaltedBody: A verified setup dispute exposed secret information. This game cannot continue. You can export its history before leaving.
onlineGameStoppedBody: The game cannot continue on this device. You can export its history before leaving.
onlineResumeProgress: Restoring your game and reconnecting to the players…
onlineResumeFailed: This game could not be restored. If it is open in another tab, return there. Otherwise, keep this browser's saved data and try again.
onlineStatsScope: Verified games played on this device
onlineSavedLoadFailed: Saved online games could not be loaded.
onlineSavedPartial_one: 1 other online game saved here can’t be opened right now.
onlineSavedPartial_other: {{count}} other online games saved here can’t be opened right now.
onlineSavedNoneAvailable_one: 1 online game saved here can’t be opened right now.
onlineSavedNoneAvailable_other: {{count}} online games saved here can’t be opened right now.
networkSettingsDescription: Most players can use the defaults. Changes apply the next time you join a game.
networkServerHint: Used for rooms you create. When you join a friend, their invitation handles this for you.
networkRelayHint: Relay only hides your IP address from other players and requires a TURN server.
networkTurnEndpointHint: Optional HTTPS endpoint provided by your TURN operator. TURN settings are saved on this device and never included in invitations.
networkSettingsInvalid: Check the server URLs and TURN credentials. Relay-only connections need a TURN server or a credentials endpoint.
invitationDenseQr: This code is quite long. Copy and paste it if the camera cannot read it.
invitationCameraFailed: The camera could not read a code. You can paste it instead.
manualReconnectHint: Exchange codes with any player who is still connected to this game.
manualAutomaticReconnect: Reconnecting to {{players}} automatically. Keep this tab open.
manualInviteHint: Invite one friend at a time. Send your code, then enter the reply they send back.
manualConnected: Connected. You can continue in the room or invite another player.
manualReconnected: Connection restored. You can return to the board.
manualAnswerHint: Send your reply code back to the friend who invited you.
manualSendOffer: Send this invitation code to your friend.
manualSendAnswer: Send this reply code back to your friend. Keep this page open.
manualGatherIncomplete: The connection check took too long. If you cannot connect, create a fresh invitation or open Connection help.
manualWaitingForAnswer: Waiting for your friend to enter your reply…
manualHaveOffer: I have an invitation code from another player
manualFailed: The connection could not be completed. Check that you have the right code, or create a new invitation.
manualConnectionHint: Invite friends by sending a code and entering their reply.
manualJoinDescription: Paste your friend’s invitation link or code, or scan its QR code.
transferSourceTitle: Move this seat to another device
transferReturnTitle: Return this player to their device
returnableSeatTitle: {{player}} is played by a bot on this device
returnableSeatBody: When they are back, send them a return link. They open it on their original device and get their seat back with a new key.
recoveredSelfTitle: A bot is playing your seat
retiredSelfTitle: This device no longer plays seat {{seat}}
retiredSelfBody: If you moved the seat to another device, continue there. If the other players replaced you with a bot while you were away, ask the player whose device hosts it to send you a return link from their board, then open it on this device.
recoveredSelfBody: The other players replaced you with a bot while you were away, and your hand was visible to them. To take seat {{seat}} back, ask the player whose device hosts the bot to send you a return link from their board, then open it on this device.
transferReturnHint: The returning player must open this invitation on their original device. That device signs with its retired game key; recovered bot authority stays active until the new key is certified.
transferReturnDestinationHint: Your hand was visible to other players while a bot played for you. This original device signs a return request with its retired game key; it cannot vote or move until the new key is certified.
transferDestinationTitle: Join this seat on this device
transferSourceHint: Choose the device that should take over this seat, then confirm the move.
transferDestinationHint: Keep this page open while the current device approves the move and this device loads the seat.
transferStartHint: Open this invitation only if you intend to take over the seat. Starting connects this device to the current one.
transferOpenFailed: Could not open the seat transfer. Try again.
transferInvalidInvite: This seat transfer invitation is invalid.
transferOldDeviceWarning: When the move completes, the old device will stop controlling this seat.
transferPhase_awaiting-confirmation: Choose a device and confirm before the seat can move.
transferPhase_awaiting-authorization: Waiting for the players to approve the move…
transferPhase_awaiting-private: Preparing the seat’s private game data…
transferPhase_awaiting-readiness: Waiting for the new device to confirm readiness…
transferPhase_awaiting-certification: Recording the approved move in the game…
transferPhase_awaiting-receipt: The move is recorded. Waiting for the new device to finish loading it…
transferPhase_cancelled-awaiting-receipt: The game recorded the cancellation. The other device has not confirmed receipt.
transferPhase_activated: Move complete. This device no longer controls the seat.
transferPhase_cancelled: The move was cancelled. The original device keeps control.
transferDestinationActivated: The move is complete. This device can now open the game.
transferDestinationCancelled: The move was cancelled. This device did not take over the seat.
connectionDiagnosticsHealthHint: The room service is not responding. Players who are already connected may still be able to play.
connectionDiagnosticsTestFailed: The connection test could not finish. Check your network settings and try again.
connectionDiagnosticsGatherTimeout: The check took too long. These are the connections found so far.
connectionDiagnosticsTryTurnOrNetwork: If players cannot connect, try the same Wi-Fi or a mobile hotspot. More options are available in Settings.
chatEmpty: No messages yet. Say hello or send a quick reaction.
chatTooLong: Keep your message to 300 characters or fewer.
chatFailed: Chat could not save or send that message. Try again.
onlineHistoryActionFailed: Could not finish this action. Reload the list before trying again.
onlineHistoryDeleteWarning: This removes the game from this device. You will not be able to resume it here. Other players and exported replays are unaffected.
onlineHistoryDeleteBusy: This game is open in another tab. Close it before removing the saved copy.
onlineGameVoidBody: The remaining players agreed that recovery could not complete. This game has ended without a winner.
onlineGameVoidHistory: You can inspect the board or leave. The saved history remains available, and this game does not count towards your statistics.
scenarioStandardAbout: The 19-hex island for two to four players, generated fresh for every game.
scenarioStandardFixedAbout: One hand-picked 19-hex layout for two to four players, the same every game.
scenarioFiveSixAbout: A 30-hex island with a bigger bank and deck. After each turn, every other player gets a special build phase.
scenarioNewHorizonsAbout: Settle one big home island, then sail out to the small islands scattered around it. Each new island you reach is worth 2 extra points, and gold fields glitter offshore. First to 14 points wins.
scenarioNewHorizonsLargeAbout: The same voyage on a wider sea: a bigger home island, eight small islands to claim and a race to 16 points. Needs the five and six player rules.
scenarioFourIslesAbout: Four equal islands, a channel of open water between each. Start on one island or split your two settlements across two, then sail to the others: the first settlement on each new island scores 2 points. Race to 13.
scenarioFourIslesLargeAbout: Four broad islands for five or six players, with two deserts and four gold fields between them. Each new island scores 2 points. First to 13 wins.
scenarioFogboundAbout: Two islands face each other across a bank of fog. A road or ship that touches the fog uncovers what hides there: forest, hills, gold or empty sea. There are no island points here, the discoveries are the prize. First to 12.
scenarioFogboundLargeAbout: Two larger islands, a desert on each, face each other across a wide bank of fog for five or six players. Every road or ship that touches the fog uncovers land, gold or open sea. No island points, first to 12.
scenarioDesertCrossingAbout: One island cut in two by a strip of desert. Everyone starts on the west side. Cross the sands or sail round them to claim the east side and four corner islets, 2 points for each. First to 13.
scenarioDesertCrossingLargeAbout: A wider island split by a longer strip of sand. Five or six players start on the west side, then race across the desert or round it for the east side and four corner islets, 2 points each. First to 13.
scenarioNewHorizonsKnightsAbout: The New Horizons voyage with commodities, city improvements, knights and the barbarians. Ships count as roads for your knights, who can stand guard at sea. The pirate only sails in after the first barbarian attack. First to 16.
scenarioNewHorizonsKnightsLarge: New Horizons with Cities & Knights (5–6 players)
scenarioNewHorizonsKnightsLargeAbout: The wider New Horizons sea with the full Cities & Knights rules and a special build phase after every turn. First to 18.
scenarioFourIslesKnightsAbout: Four islands, one barbarian fleet. Your knights reach the other islands along your ships, and every island is attacked at once, so guard the far shores too. Commodities, improvements and 2 points per new island. First to 15.
scenarioFourIslesKnightsLarge: Four Isles with Cities & Knights (5–6 players)
scenarioFourIslesKnightsLargeAbout: The four broad islands for five or six players, with commodities, knights, the barbarians and a special build phase after every turn. First to 15.
scenarioFogboundKnightsAbout: Sail into the fog while the barbarians gather. Discoveries pay resources, never commodities, and every city on newly found land still counts for the barbarians. First to 14.
scenarioFogboundKnightsLargeAbout: The wide fog bank for five or six players, with the full Cities & Knights rules and a special build phase after every turn. First to 14.
scenarioDesertCrossingKnightsAbout: Cross the desert strip or sail round it while the barbarians close in on every island at once. Commodities, improvements and knights as in Cities & Knights. First to 15.
scenarioDesertCrossingKnightsLarge: Desert Crossing with Cities & Knights (5–6 players)
scenarioDesertCrossingKnightsLargeAbout: The long desert crossing for five or six players, with commodities, knights, the barbarians and a special build phase after every turn. First to 15.
scenarioOpenSeaAbout: A fresh archipelago every game: one home island and a scatter of small ones, some rich in gold. Each new island you reach scores 1 extra point. First to 12.
scenarioOpenSeaLargeAbout: A wider archipelago for five or six players, with a large home island, more islets and more gold. Each new island scores 1 extra point. First to 12.
scenarioOpenSeaKnightsAbout: A fresh archipelago every game, with commodities, knights and the barbarians closing in on every island at once. Each new island scores 1 extra point. First to 14.
scenarioOpenSeaKnightsLarge: Open Sea with Cities & Knights (5–6 players)
scenarioOpenSeaKnightsLargeAbout: The wider generated archipelago for five or six players, with the full Cities & Knights rules and a special build phase after every turn. First to 14.
scenarioKnightsAbout: Cities make commodities as well as resources. Spend them on three improvement tracks for special powers and metropolises, and roll a third die for the event. First to 13.
scenarioKnightsLargeAbout: The commodity and city-improvement game on the larger island, with a bigger bank and a special build phase after every turn. First to 13.
expansionFiveSixSeats: turned on automatically for five or six players
pickStealCardHint: Off: steal as soon as you choose a player.
onlineUpdateLatest: This device already has the newest version of Hexfield. Ask the other players to update.
publicReplayOlderVersion: This replay was created with an older version of Hexfield ({{version}}). This version cannot verify its history, so it cannot be shown.
publicReplayNewerVersion: This replay was created with a newer version of Hexfield ({{version}}). Update the app to open it.
